text:
carla: FYI I've pushed nebula-13b weights to gs://redwood-models/nebula/13b/v1/, config YAML at repo:models/nebula/13b/serving.yaml. Ready for tokenizer check + perf runs. Can someone pick this up? :wave:

ben: I'll validate tokenizer today. Quick question — does this model expect a separate pad token? The HF tokenizer metadata didn't list one.

alice: I looked at the tokenizer files. vocab.json has <|pad|> but special_tokens_map.json is missing pad mapping. Likely mismatch when exporting. Diff snippet: `{"pad_token": null} -> {"pad_token": "<|pad|>"}`. We should add pad_token to special_tokens_map before conversion.

carla: Good catch. I can patch and push a hotfix to the export script. Will also update serving.yaml to set `pad_token_id` explicitly.

darren: Perf plan: I'll run latency and throughput sweeps on dedicated-rt1 (A100s). Want runs for seq_len = [512, 1024, 2048] and batch = [1,4,8,16] + streaming tests. Any other configs?

ben: Add runs for quantized (int8) variant too if possible. Also run with `--kv-cache=true` vs false to see memory/latency tradeoffs.

carla: Yes int8 path available at gs://redwood-models/nebula/13b/v1/int8.q8. Also note we had a tokenizer edge where some inputs append extra newline causing offset errors in reranking tests. Ben, can you add a small prompt normalization test?

ben: On it. I'll run tokenizer normalization on a 200-sample prompt set and dump mismatches. Expecting ~0.5% issues but will confirm.

infra-bot: deploy/dedicated-rt1 queue accepted job 47293 for user darren. ETA ~6m.

darren: Starting perf script I'm using:```bash
./bench/run_perf.sh \
  --model-path gs://redwood-models/nebula/13b/v1/ \
  --quant int8|fp16 \
  --seq-len 2048 \
  --batch 8 \
  --kv-cache true \
  --iters 100 \
  --warmup 10 \
  --out logs/nebula13b/```
Posting results to the perf dashboard when done.

perf-bot: CI perf-check: analysis started for job 47293. Baseline (sable14b) latency @ seq2048,batch8 = 220ms/token. Will compare.

carla: small config note — serving.yaml currently has `max_batch_size: 16` but runtime kernels show degraded tail latencies past 8 for seq2048. Maybe set default to 8 and allow bursts to 16. I'll open a PR for config change.

alice: Also double-check tokenizer pad_id mapping propagates to the model config: `model.config.pad_token_id == tokenizer.pad_token_id`. I saw a mismatch in past exports that caused sampler to crash on padding only batches.

ben: Ran normalization tests — 200 prompts -> 3 mismatches. Uploading diffs: https://logs.redwood.ai/ben/nebula-tokenizer-diffs/200_202.json . Most are trailing spaces + `\u00A0`. I'll add a pre-tokenize strip and unicode normalize.

darren: First perf pass done (fp16, kv-cache=true). Quick numbers: seq2048,batch8 -> p50=210ms/token, p95=490ms/token, throughput=420 tok/s per GPU. Int8 pass starting now. Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/darren/nebula13b/run_2145009876_fp16.log

carla: Nice. That p50 is within our target but p95 is a bit high. Could be GC from KV cache spikes or kernel fallback. Anyone able to run per-layer profiler?

alice: I'll run nvprof heatmap on a smaller test to see if attention kernel is falling back. Also look at memory fragmentation. For int8, watch for dequant/quant overhead spikes.

perf-bot: int8 run complete. Metrics uploaded to dashboard. Preliminary delta vs fp16: avg latency -6%, throughput +10%, but p95 variance up ~12%. See dashboard: https://perf.redwood.ai/nebula13b/2145009876

ben: From tokenizer side, after strip+NFKC we lost those 3 mismatches. Pushed patch to `models/nebula/13b/tokenizer_fix` branch. Please review: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/models/pulls/1423

carla: Thanks. Can someone do a quick config PR review and approve the serving.yaml change? It's minor: set default max_batch_size: 8 and add `allow_burst: true` with burst_limit: 16. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/infra/pulls/879

darren: I'll review in 30m. Also scheduling a nightly full-sweep (all seq_len x batches x quant) — expect completed artifacts by tomorrow morning. Posting job id when queued.

infra-bot: job queued 47299 for nightly-sweep. ETA completion 2024-06-18T07:10:00Z.

carla: One more ask — could the bench harness attach a token-level cost estimate? We want to compare unit economics vs other models. If not now, add a TODO on the perf ticket.

ben: Added TODO in ticket #ML-2287.

alice: I'll also add an eval that runs reranking on the normalized prompts to check end-to-end quality delta from int8 changes.

carla: Awesome. Thanks all — I'll wait for darren's nightly artifacts then we can promote to catalog-staging. Ping me on the PR for fast-merge. :rocket:

darren: job 47299 started. Will post final dashboard link when complete.

perf-bot: nightly sweep started. Tracking id ns-214500-nebula.

carla: (cc @darren @ben @alice) — please add any follow-ups to the ticket. Closing thread for async updates. :white_check_mark:
